choices.label: Close out, no action
choices.prompt: Treat the one-sentence confirmation as final and take no further action this turn. Do not call tools, edit files, change settings or connect services. If a later message asks for live Cloudflare data, state plainly that cloudflare.docs.read and cloudflare.account.read are unavailable in this profile and that advice comes only from the pinned Cloudflare Skills and MCP references.

choices.label: State limits for future tasks
choices.prompt: Without calling tools or changing anything, write a short note (a few sentences) on what this advice-only profile can and cannot do: it can advise on Wrangler, Workers, Pages, R2, D1, KV and DNS from the pinned references, but cannot read account state, docs or deploy. Keep it as text only and stop there.

choices.label: Queue a real Cloudflare question
choices.prompt: If there is an actual Cloudflare question behind this check, describe it (e.g. a Wrangler config, Workers routing or D1 binding issue) and I will advise from the pinned Cloudflare Skills and MCP references only, flagging that no live account or docs verification is possible. No tools, deployments or settings changes will be made.

recommendation.rationale: The stated goal was a single read-only confirmation that this profile is advice-only and Cloudflare access is unavailable, and the agent's final message delivered exactly that one sentence with no tool calls or changes. Closing out honors the explicit 'no new work' constraint and the workflow instruction to avoid repeated effort. The main tradeoff is that next-2's capability note could preempt future confusion, but it was not requested and would be unsolicited output; next-3 would invite new work the user expressly prohibited. Assumption: no undisclosed live Cloudflare question exists — if one does, next-3 would become appropriate, which is why the scores keep some mass there.
